remote_experiment.display_name: B0–B3 三种子有限风险与完整160维多解耦
remote_experiment.description: 对应CE旧门控cos E200父权重上40轮第二阶段，B0纯CE、B1固定覆盖有限风险、B2条件动作、B3完整160维组差R；固定逐row clean测试。
remote_experiment.authorization: 2026-10-11用户提交最新Pro设计报告并要求“按照报告，开始追求目标”；按报告先源审计，再B0–B3×三seed，每方案40epoch，4进程/GPU，自动clean。

notes: 原始纯CE父权重为唯一初始化；前轮C0/C1/C2/C3不作为新权重。
源审计是同一6300物理L_s样本分别观察三份父权重，不能算18900独立样本。
不增加unbounded增强CE、默认Fishr、额外身份骨干、交互网络、在线刷新或未验证物理特征支路。
单向有限margin=log95；weights keep=.1/LT=1/R=1；ramp444；无CE梯度比例校准。

test_completion_plan.checkpoint_selection: final E40 only; no early selection

physical_actions.objective: maximize fixed-parent true-IQ logit-margin drop; fixed classifier scale 30

temporal.phase_process: three smooth sine modes; clipped Gaussian coefficients

fractional_delay.operator: zero-pad 256 each side, FFT phase shift, crop original central 256
fractional_delay.zero_delay: exact value identity with differentiable delay path
fractional_delay.boundary_assumption: IQ outside observed 256-sample window is zero; sinc interpolation may ring near truncated edges
fractional_delay.scope: new fixed mild timing perturbation, not satellite/channel simulation or calibrated source error

physical_actions.random: explicit private CPU generators; no global RNG consumption
